column7: path
column8: desc

column7: Log Analytics workspace > Usage and estimated costs > Daily cap
column8: Caps ALL ingestion for the day when hit; security tables stop too. Use commitment tiers + DCR transforms instead of caps on SOC workspaces.

column7: Microsoft Sentinel > Settings > Pricing
column8: Fixed daily GB tiers beat pay-as-you-go at volume; tier changes have a lock-in window.

column7: Log Analytics workspace > Tables + role assignments
column8: Grant readers specific tables only; verify with a scoped test account.

column7: ARM: workspaces/purge API
column8: Irreversible GDPR-style deletes; slow (up to days); audit the request ids.

column7: Defender portal > System > Settings > Microsoft Sentinel > Workspaces
column8: Onboard the Sentinel workspace into the unified SOC experience; pick the primary workspace.

column7: Microsoft Sentinel > Settings > Remove Microsoft Sentinel
column8: Offboards Sentinel from the workspace; rules and automation go with it; data stays per retention. Read the order-of-operations first.

column7: Log Analytics workspace > Usage and estimated costs > Data retention
column8: Interactive retention default for all tables; Sentinel-enabled workspaces include 90 days free.

column7: Log Analytics workspace > Tables > (table) > Table plan
column8: Cheaper tiers cut ingestion cost but limit query features and rule support; verify detections before demoting a table.

column7: Microsoft Sentinel > Settings > Analytics settings > Anomalies
column8: UEBA-powered anomaly detections; tune thresholds per anomaly instead of disabling the family.

column7: Analytics > Fusion (advanced multistage attack detection)
column8: Correlates weak signals into high-confidence incidents; keep enabled; configure source signals.

column7: STIX objects via the TI upload API (app registration)
column8: Push indicators from your TIP with an app registration; the modern replacement for the Graph tiIndicators route.

column7: Configuration > Data connectors > Threat Intelligence TAXII
column8: Poll TAXII 2.x collections; set collection id and polling frequency per feed.

column7: Microsoft Sentinel > Search > Search job
column8: Asynchronous hunts across long-term retention and cheap tiers; results land in a *_SRCH table; billed per scanned GB.

column7: Log Analytics workspace > Tables > (table) > Restore
column8: Rehydrate a time slice from long-term retention into a hot *_RST table; time-boxed and billed; delete when done.

column7: Workspace access control mode + resource permissions
column8: Lets resource owners query only logs of resources they can read without workspace-wide rights.

column7: Microsoft Sentinel > Configuration > Workspace manager
column8: Publish content from a central workspace to member workspaces; the MSSP at-scale distribution path.

column7: Dedicated cluster + Key Vault key on the workspace
column8: CMK requires a dedicated cluster and never comes off; a compliance decision with permanent cost floor.

column7: Azure Monitor Private Link Scope + workspace network isolation
column8: Locks ingestion/query to private endpoints; misconfigured access mode silently drops public agents.

column7: _Im_* functions over raw tables
column8: Write detections against normalized schemas (_Im_Dns and friends) so one rule covers every source; slower than raw on huge scans.

column7: workspace(\"name\").Table in KQL
column8: Query up to 100 workspaces in one statement; rules support fewer; latency grows with fan-out. Lighthouse handles the auth.

column7: ingestion_time() minus TimeGenerated
column8: Minutes of delay are normal and vary per connector class; measure with ingestion_time() before blaming a rule window.

column7: Logs > save query as function
column8: Share parsers and helpers as workspace functions; version them via repositories to stop copy-paste drift.
